levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Labels are not read closely, or no specific never-mix pair is identified.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: At least one real never-mix pair is correctly identified with a reason drawn from the actual label text.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Same as proficient, and the learner explains the hazard mechanism, such as the specific fumes produced, not just that the pair is dangerous.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Label directions for dwell time or ventilation are not followed, or the trusted adult is not present throughout use.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The product is used exactly as the label directs, with a trusted adult supervising the entire time.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Same as proficient, and the learner can explain why each specific direction, such as dwell time or ventilation, matters for that product.

lookFors: The trusted adult was present for gathering, sorting, and product use, not only signing off afterward.
The named hazard pair and the surface-cleaning description are specific to the real products and label text used, not generic cleaning advice.

A learner who completed the simulation/equal-credit alternative instead of the real-world version should be scored on this same rubric using the alternative submission as the evidence — using the sanctioned alternative is not itself a reason to score lower.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
